list.title: Recipes
list.subtitle: {{household}}'s recipe book
list.emptyBody: Add the family's first recipe: the Sunday one, the one that never fails, or one you want to try.
list.noResultsBody: Try another word or remove a filter.
list.kitchenInvite: Tell us which utensils you have at home and we'll show which recipes you can make.

detail.scaledNotice: Quantities recalculated. The original recipe doesn't change. Check times and dish size: they don't scale the same way.
detail.archivedBanner: This recipe is archived. It doesn't show in the recipe book or in searches.
detail.deleteBody: It will be deleted for the whole household, with its photo. This can't be undone. To just hide it, archive it.
detail.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted or belong to another household.
detail.autoTagPersonalised: Automatic tag based on your real times

form.title: Title
form.descriptionPlaceholder: One line to know what it is
form.baseServingsHint: The quantities you write are for this number of servings.
form.photoHint: JPG, PNG or WebP. We shrink it before uploading.
form.photoAfterSave: You can add a photo after saving the recipe.
form.photoTooBig: The image is too large. Try another one.
form.ingredientsHint: Write each ingredient as you'd say it: “400 g rice”, “2 onions”, “salt to taste”. We split out the quantity when it's safe.
form.pasteHint: One per line, as you would say it: «400 g rice», «salt to taste». You can review them one by one afterwards.
form.pasteStepsHint: Paste the method. If it is numbered (1., 2., Step 3…), each number starts a step; otherwise each paragraph or line becomes a step. You can review them before saving.
form.stepPlaceholder: What to do in this step
form.timesHint: Tell apart the time you're working from waiting time (oven, resting…).
form.totalAuto: Leave it empty to add up active and passive.
form.discardBody: You'll lose the changes to this recipe.

validation.titleRequired: Give it a title (120 characters at most).
validation.url: Enter a link starting with http:// or https://.
validation.equipmentRequired: Add at least one utensil to the preparation method, or choose “Not specified” or “Nothing special needed”.

form.pasteIngredientsPlaceholder:
400 g rice
2 onions
Salt to taste
form.pasteStepsPlaceholder:
1. Chop the onion.
2. Fry for 10 minutes.
3. Add the rice.
form.autoTagsHint: Tags such as “Quick”, “Easy”, “No oven” or “Air fryer” are worked out from the times, difficulty and utensils.

catalog.ownerOnlyCreate: It isn't in the catalogue. Only the household owner can create new categories, tags and utensils.

equipment.title: Utensils needed
equipment.formHint: Optional. Helps you see which recipes you can make with what you have at home.

statusHint.unspecified: Nobody knows what's needed: the recipe is never hidden because of equipment.
statusHint.none: It can be made in any kitchen.
statusHint.defined: Pick the utensils. If there's another way to make it, add an alternative method.

equipment.methodLabelHint: For example: “In the oven” or “Lékué in the microwave”.
equipment.addMethodHint: The recipe can be made if you have every utensil of at least one method.
equipment.detailUnspecified: This recipe doesn't say which utensils it needs.
equipment.notConfigured: To know whether you can make it, tell us which utensils you have at home.
equipment.optionalHint: They help but are not essential: the recipe is not hidden if you do not have them.

estimates.originalKept: The recipe's own times don't change; this estimate is used for filters and automatic tags.

history.title: History
history.logHint: It's optional and helps estimate how long it really takes you.
history.empty: Nobody has logged this recipe yet.
history.privacy: Everyone in the household sees the history; only whoever created an entry can edit or delete it.

validation.totalRequired: Enter the total time in minutes.

filters.title: Filter recipes

availability.auto: I can make it or no information

filters.kitchenNotConfigured: You haven't told us your utensils yet, so nothing is hidden.
filters.durationHint: Times use your personal or household estimate when there are at least 3 entries.
filters.allHiddenByEquipment: The matching recipes need utensils you don't have.

kitchen.title: Kitchen equipment
kitchen.subtitle: What's in {{household}}'s kitchen. Shared with the whole household.
kitchen.listHint: Tick what you have. Anyone in the household can change it and it syncs for everyone.
kitchen.quickHint: Tap what you have from these basics. Nothing is ticked in advance; you can complete the list afterwards.
kitchen.manageOwner: Create your household's own utensils or hide the ones you don't use.
kitchen.manageMember: Only the household owner can create or hide utensils.

catalogs.title: Categories, tags and utensils
catalogs.subtitle: Catalogue of the active household.
catalogs.memberNotice: You can use the whole catalogue; only the household owner can create, edit or hide items.
catalogs.globalHint: It's the same for every household and can't be edited. Hiding an item removes it from lists without removing it from recipes that already use it.

deleteBody.category: It will be removed from every recipe in the household. Recipes aren't deleted.
deleteBody.tag: It will be removed from every recipe in the household. Recipes aren't deleted.
deleteBody.utensil: It will be removed from recipes and from the household's equipment.

catalogs.name: Name
catalogs.keywordsHint: Comma-separated. When analysing this household's recipes, QuéComo suggests this item if these words appear.

classification.title: Smart classification
classification.hint: QuéComo suggests categories, tags and utensils from what you write. Accept, change or dismiss them; nothing is required.
classification.automaticHint: They depend on times, difficulty and utensils, and update when you change them.
classification.empty: No suggestions yet. They appear as you write the title, ingredients or steps.
classification.utensilsHint: Say whether each utensil is required, an alternative or optional. Nothing is marked as required without your confirmation.
classification.dietWarning: Only confirm it if you have checked every ingredient and its label. QuéComo does not guarantee that a recipe is suitable for allergies or intolerances.

reason.dietNoMeat: Every ingredient is recognised and none is meat or fish.
reason.dietPlantOnly: Every ingredient is recognised and all are plant-based.
reason.dietIncomplete: Cannot be sure: some ingredients are not recognised.
reason.freezingNotes: The freezing notes say it can be frozen.
